rationale: The short thesis has largely played out — price dropped from $35.40 to a low of $34.89 — but the last 15+ candles show price consolidating tightly in the $34.89–$35.07 band with progressively higher lows (34.89 → 34.94 → 34.96 → 35.00 → 35.02), suggesting absorption and loss of downward momentum. The ATR has compressed to $0.06, indicating the impulsive leg is exhausted, and continued holding risks giving back open P&L into a potential bounce rather than capturing further meaningful downside.
